title: I think a lot of people here know what I do.
hook: I think a lot of people here know what I do.
caption:
I think a lot of people here know what I do.

But maybe not really why I do it.

Sport has been part of my life for as long as I can remember, and American football probably shaped me more than anything else.

It gave me some of the best moments of my life, but also some of the hardest.

Pressure. Injuries. Doubt. Starting again. Trying to prove myself. Falling short. Getting better.

And somewhere along the way, I realized that what I loved most wasn’t only competing.

It was the process.

title: A workout can leave you sweaty, sore, and completely exhausted.
hook: A workout can leave you sweaty, sore, and completely exhausted.
caption:
A workout can leave you sweaty, sore, and completely exhausted.

But that doesn't automatically mean it was a good workout.

Somewhere along the way, we've been conditioned to believe that the harder it is to walk out of the gym, the more effective the workout must have been.

Sweating buckets.
Legs shaking.
Barely making it up the stairs afterward.
Sore for the next three days.

"Now THAT was a workout."

But exhaustion isn't the goal of training.
